title: FX235 a replay records its tools: the overview
caption: What FX235 builds: a recorded tool, every tool wrapped in it, the guide's baseline recorded again, and the close.

cards.title: FX235 A replay records its tools
cards.text: A free replay plays back what each tool answered, so a docs edit can't make it stale.

cards.title: A recorded tool
cards.text: Records a tool's answer, and plays it back when the model is replayed (2).

cards.title: Every tool, wrapped
cards.text: The one place every tool enters an engine, subagents' too (3).

cards.title: The baseline again
cards.text: Recorded live once more, then replayed over an empty docs folder (4).

cards.title: The close
cards.text: The design docs, the guide, the lesson, the plan deleted (5).
